setup-worktree-unix: if [ -f "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/.env" ]; then cp "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/.env" .env; elif [ -f "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/.env.example" ]; then cp "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/.env.example" .env; fi
setup-worktree: if [ -f "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/.env" ]; then cp "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/.env" .env; elif [ -f "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/.env.example" ]; then cp "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/.env.example" .env; fi

worktrees.name: frontend
worktrees.description: Next.js UI — after setup run: npm run dev:frontend (alias: npm run dev)

worktrees.name: backend
worktrees.description: Spring BFF + stack — after setup run: npm run dev:stack (Docker backend+mongo then Next) or npm run dev:host (Gradle bootRun + Next)
worktrees.setup: echo 'ROLE=backend' > .cursor/.backend && npm ci && chmod +x services/atxfinance-backend/gradlew 2>/dev/null || true

worktrees.name: reviewer
worktrees.description: Pre-merge gate — after setup run: npm run ci:gate then npm run build:stack (Next + Gradle test)
worktrees.setup: echo 'ROLE=reviewer' > .cursor/.reviewer && npm ci && chmod +x services/atxfinance-backend/gradlew 2>/dev/null || true
